'''Thunder Axe Fortress''' is a stronghold occupied by the [[Burning Blade]] cult founded by [[Klass Metalfist]]. Within the fortress they store the artifact known as the [[Hand of Iruxos]], which is used to open demon portals at [[Mannoroc Coven]]. It is interesting to note that the red crystal containing the demon holding the Demon Box (which containts the Hand of Iruxos) may hypothetically be identical in its composition to [[bloodstone ore|bloodstone]] - material frequently used in summoning demons. Thunder Axe Fortress also houses the [[Sceptre of Light]] - an immensely powerful artifact that the Burning Blade stole from the naga. [[Azore Aldamort]] seeks to recover this artifact for the [[Argent Dawn]]. [[Tyranis Malem]] resides here, a traitor to his people, and a keen pioneer in demonic magics.
